'''Britton Weaver Johnsen''' (born July 8, 1979) is an American retired professional [[basketball player]] who played briefly in the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He graduated from [[Murray High School (Utah)|Murray High School]] and the [[University of Utah]]. Born in [[Salt Lake City, Utah|Salt Lake City]], his hometown is [[Murray, Utah]]. Johnsen is a member of [[the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints]].<ref>[http://www.sptimes.com/2003/11/17/Sports/Johnsen_has_faith_to_.shtml Johnsen has faith to keep knocking.]</ref>

== College career ==
Johnsen played [[college basketball]] with the [[University of Utah]]'s [[Utah Utes men's basketball|Utah Utes]].

== Professional career ==
Johnsen was selected with the #19 pick of the [[Continental Basketball Association]] (CBA) draft by the [[Gary Steelheads]] in 2003. He then played briefly for the [[Orlando Magic]] in the [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] in the [[2003–04 NBA season]] averaging 2.1 points and 2.1 [[rebound (basketball)|rebounds]] per game. He then played with the [[New Orleans Hornets]] during the 2004 NBA preseason and with the [[Indiana Pacers]] in the [[2004–05 NBA season]] averaging 2.0 points and 1.7 rebounds per game.

He also played with the summer league squad of the [[Utah Jazz]] at the [[Rocky Mountain Revue]] and with the Jazz during their preseason training camp in the year 2008.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20080919081414/http://www.deseretnews.com/article/1,5143,700259931,00.html Ex-Ute Britton Johnsen at Jazz camp].</ref>

He also played in the [[NBA D-League]] with the [[Fayetteville Patriots]], the [[Bakersfield Jam]], and the [[Utah Flash]]<ref>[http://www.nba.com/dleague/utah/johnsen_080110.html Flash acquire Johnsen from Bakersfield Jam.]</ref> and in the CBA with the [[Idaho Stampede]].

=== Overseas ===
Johnsen also played overseas for several professional clubs. He moved to the [[Liga ACB|Spanish ACB League]] club [[CB Lucentum Alicante|Etosa Alicante]] in 2005. He then moved to the [[A1 Ethniki|Greek A1 League]] club [[Panellinios BC|Panellinios Athens]] in 2006.

In 2007, he joined the [[Ligue Nationale de Basketball|French Pro A League]] club [[Élan Béarnais Pau-Orthez]]. In 2008, he moved to the [[Turkish Basketball League|Turkish League]] club [[Galatasaray Café Crown]]. In 2009, he joined the Greek team [[P.A.O.K. B.C.|PAOK Thessaloniki]].<ref>[http://www.paokbc.gr/paokbc/index.php PAOK signs Johnsen. {{in lang|el}}] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090104022630/http://www.paokbc.gr/paokbc/index.php |date=January 4, 2009 }}</ref> A year later, he signed with [[Panellinios B.C.]] In 2011, he joined the Argentine team [[Quilmes de Mar del Plata]].<ref>[http://www.latinbasket.com/player.asp?Cntry=ARG&PlayerID=35911&AmNotSure=1 Britton Johnson]. latinbasket.</ref>
